episode_title: Episode 331: Your Leadership Legacy is Your People

real_qa.q: What percentage of employees felt there was a leadership crisis in corporate America according to U.S. News World Report research in 2023?
real_qa.r: According to a 2023 study by U.S. News World Report and Harrisville, 78 percent of individuals felt there was a leadership crisis in corporate America, and 86 percent felt there was a leadership crisis in society as a whole. William Davis cited these statistics to illustrate the severity of the current leadership environment and why employees are more willing to leave for other opportunities.
real_qa.requete: U.S. News World Report 2023 leadership crisis percentage

real_qa.q: What is the primary criterion William Davis uses when hiring leaders to ensure they have the right motivations?
real_qa.r: William Davis ensures that people who want to be leaders truly desire leadership for the right reason—not for title, perceived power, or additional money, but because they want to develop people, invest in them, and help them succeed. He makes clear that leaders must establish genuine trust with their teams so people understand they will not be sabotaged or constantly questioned.
real_qa.requete: how to hire leaders right motivations people development

real_qa.q: How does The Leadership Blueprint define culture versus environment in organizations?
real_qa.r: William Davis prefers the term environment to culture, emphasizing principles rooted in the golden rule: treating people with respect, caring about them, investing in them, and winning together. He argues that building an environment where trust, empathy, respect, and success flourish prevents putting people at odds against each other and avoids creating cutthroat competition that damages team dynamics.

real_qa.q: What role does stacked ranking systems play in creating sabotage and distrust in corporate environments?
real_qa.r: Stacked ranking systems, where employees compete against each other for bonuses with unequal distributions like 110 percent versus 70 percent, encourage people to undercut each other and withhold information to make themselves look better. This practice puts employees in a position of uncertainty about how they are perceived and forces them to adopt self-protective behaviors rather than collaborative teamwork.
real_qa.requete: stacked ranking system sabotage corporate competition

real_qa.q: What personal experience did William Davis use to build trust with a nervous young employee through golf?
real_qa.r: William Davis took a 23-24 year old employee who was constantly nervous about being fired out to golf to meet him in a comfortable arena outside the office. When Davis deliberately hit a terrible tee shot and joked that he did it intentionally so the employee would feel better about his golf game, it broke down the barrier between them and showed the employee that his leader was both business-oriented and genuinely interested in having fun and understanding what matters to people.
real_qa.requete: building trust employees meeting outside office

real_qa.q: What is the Balanced Framework research finding regarding stress factors and passion factors in employee retention?
real_qa.r: The Balanced Framework research, which originated in call centers, found that while stress factors are unavoidable in any job and cannot be completely eliminated, organizations can balance them by adding passion factors on the other side of the scale. The research identified that one of the heaviest passion factors is having a boss who genuinely knows and understands you, making leadership connection critical to counterbalancing job stress.
real_qa.requete: Balanced Framework stress factors passion factors
